## Custom Site — Argus Media

First instance of the **Custom Site — <Label>** naming convention.

**Pipeline:**
1. Manual Trigger
2. HTTP Request → `https://www.argusmedia.com/api/news` (Argus public news feed)
3. Code: Extract URLs → loop items, take `links[1].href` (public www URL) + `datePublished` as `source_date`. Host allow-list = `argusmedia.com`. Dedup-within-batch.
4. Code: Build /research-ingest Payload → `{source_type:"Website", source_name:"Argus Media", source_category:"News", urls:[{url, source_date}, ...]}`
5. HTTP POST `/research-ingest` (httpBearerAuth, retry 3x, onError → error branch)
6. Success / Error logging

**To add a new Custom Site workflow:** duplicate this, swap the HTTP Request URL + the Extract URLs logic, update the host allow-list regex and `source_name`/`source_category` defaults.

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-06-22-001-feat-source-date-and-custom-site-intake-plan.md` (U6).
